name: RoB 2
license_note: Domain names and prompts are paraphrases. The official wording is linked, not bundled.
notes: Effect-of-assignment signalling questions. The overall is derived from the five domain judgements by the rule below; signalling answers are supporting detail only, and the official signalling-answer algorithms are not implemented.

domains.name: Randomisation process
domains.short_prompt: Whether allocation was randomised and concealed, and whether baseline differences suggest a problem.

signalling.prompt: Was the allocation sequence generated randomly?
Was allocation concealed until participants were enrolled and assigned?
Did baseline differences between groups suggest a problem with randomisation?

domains.name: Deviations from intended interventions
domains.short_prompt: Whether participants, carers, or deliverers knew the assignment and whether deviations were handled appropriately.

signalling.prompt: Were participants aware of their assigned intervention?
Were carers or people delivering the intervention aware of the assignment?
Were deviations from the intended intervention balanced between groups, or was an appropriate analysis used?

domains.name: Missing outcome data
domains.short_prompt: Whether outcome data were available for all or nearly all participants and whether missingness could bias the result.

signalling.prompt: Were outcome data available for all or nearly all randomised participants?
Is there evidence that the result was not biased by missing outcome data?
Could missingness depend on the true value of the outcome?

domains.name: Measurement of the outcome
domains.short_prompt: Whether outcome measurement was appropriate and whether assessors could have been influenced by knowing the assignment.

signalling.prompt: Was the method of measuring the outcome inappropriate?
Could measurement or ascertainment have differed between groups?
Were outcome assessors aware of the intervention received?
Could assessment have been influenced by knowledge of the intervention received?

domains.name: Selection of the reported result
domains.short_prompt: Whether the reported result was pre-specified and whether it could have been selected from multiple analyses.

signalling.prompt: Were the data analysed in accordance with a pre-specified plan?
Is the result likely to have been selected from multiple measurements, analyses, subgroups, or time points?
